name: enabled
meaning: drawn at all: UiIcon_Draw requires +0 and +1; Map_ResetSelection sets it to 1 through a 32-bit temp (0x5410e8) and Map_ActionPrev/Next skip buttons whose byte is 0 (0x541e84)

name: highlighted
meaning: second UiIcon_Draw gate; Map_ResetSelection clears it (0x541103)

name: hasExtraQuads
meaning: set by UiIcon_Setup when either the back or overlay bitmap was supplied; UiIcon_Draw draws the overlay quad only when it is set

name: quantity
meaning: item count; UiIcon_Draw prints the "x%u" label at 0x57c044 only when it is greater than 1

name: mainQuad
meaning: the item bitmap itself; always drawn

name: overlayQuad
meaning: grey (0x808080) overlay drawn under the main quad when hasExtraQuads is set

name: unk40
meaning: never read or written by UiIcon_Setup / UiIcon_Draw / UiIcon_SetFadeLevel or by the Map; present because the Map arrays of UiIcon have a 0x44 stride (imul edx,edx,0x44 at 0x53fe64 / 0x5410f3 / 0x541bed) and itemSlots start at actionSlots+4*0x44 = 0x304
